correctness.rationale: Explicit unique bijection: subalgebras containing the socle are inverse images of arbitrary V-subspaces; those avoiding it are linear graphs over totally B-isotropic U. The orthogonal quotient flag recurrence yields all I_{d,k} products. A direct coefficient comparison gives the Witt gap. Uniform Gaussian-binomial bounds give G_d=q^{d^2/4+O_q(1)} and H_d=q^{d^2/6+d/6+O_q(1)}; centered Gaussian summability proves conditional concentration and discrete-Gaussian limits. Actual standalone verify.py independently enumerates all candidate subspaces and multiplies basis vectors over prime fields, passing ten exhaustive configurations and the sample Witt-gap checks; finite evidence does not establish generality alone.
